notes: Normative registry of the CSS custom properties an implementation's stylesheet MUST read, with the default used when a host sets nothing.
Defaults are the Eureka 2.0 compiled values. `documented` marks tokens that were in the v2 README theming table; the others were used by the v2 stylesheet without being documented.
Themes are complete sets of overrides. `forced-colors` lists the system colour each token maps to under `@media (forced-colors: active)`.

--active.description: Highlight colour for active or focused components, links, the drop area

--border-width.description: Border width for panels, components, inputs

--border-style.description: Border style for panels, components, inputs

--border-color.description: Border colour for components and inputs

--border-shadow-color.description: Box-shadow colour used to draw button borders; pressed state uses a darker value

--border-color-dangerous.description: Border for destructive controls on hover and focus

--dangerous.description: Colour for warnings, errors, destructive buttons (v2 default was pure red, 3.99:1 on white; #b80000 meets AA)

--subtle.description: Subtle text colour, used in the source panel and secondary labels

--very-subtle.description: Very subtle colour, used for the drop zone border

--very-subtle-icon-opacity.description: Opacity of very subtle icons (drop zone)

--tree-line-height.description: Line height of tree nodes; a row is max(24px, this × 1em), so values below ~2 only tighten the text, never the target (06 A11Y-40)

--tree-course-line-height.description: Line height of tree nodes in coarse-pointer (touch) mode; rows are max(44px, this × 1em)

--notification-focus-color.description: Notification dismiss button hover and focus colour

--hint-opacity.description: Resting opacity of keyboard hints such as the Keyboard Shortcuts button (06 A11Y-55): knocked back until keyboard use, hover or focus, but never below 3:1 for the icon (the light default needs 0.62; the dark scheme sets 0.5)

--hint-text-opacity.description: Resting opacity of textual keyboard hints (the <kbd> shortcut labels on controls, 02 HTML-96): knocked back until keyboard use, hover or focus, but never below 4.5:1 for the text blended over its control (axe-measured; the light default needs 0.81; the dark scheme sets 0.65)

black-on-white.description: High contrast, dark text on light. Also the mapping v2 applied under -ms-high-contrast: black-on-white.

white-on-black.description: High contrast, light text on dark. Also the mapping v2 applied under -ms-high-contrast: white-on-black.

forced-colors.description: Under @media (forced-colors: active) the stylesheet MUST set these tokens to system colours and MUST NOT rely on background colour alone to convey state.
